open_questions: What are the exact dates, employing EY entity, substantive hours and leave for the 2008 accounting spell?
Were the Menzies, acting Liberal federal-director and Yes-campaign roles separate employment, secondments or overlapping duties, and which entity paid him?
What services, remuneration and substantive hours applied to Bragg PPC during the overlapping Senate campaign?
What were the ANU and Macquarie study dates and any concurrent paid work?
Was the announced November2016 FSC departure implemented, and what explains the frozen2017 endpoint?
Which Commonwealth department or political office employed him in2008–09, and on what hours?
Who employed him in early orchard, cannery and dairy work, and when?
research_notes: Systematic nationwide follow-up2026-10-01. Required research_notes added; supported existing spells preserved. Material additions: previously omitted Commonwealth advisory work and three early work activities; governance observations, education correction and stronger FSC/Menzies endpoints. No substantive full-time evidence found; totals remain null, not zero.

Government advisory role is not automatically public-service employment. Identify appointing office/department, contractual status and hours before coding.2008–09 overlaps EY/FSC at month/year precision and must not be added mechanically. Three governance roles observed2014 may be FSC representative duties; dates unknown.

Employer resignation notice is prospective: November2016 is the announced FSC cessation month, with original frozen2017 discrepancy retained. Menzies April2017 comes from indexed professional profile, replacing an inference from BCA commencement. Current own biography and2014 profile correct the earlier ANU BAcc claim without changing frozen roster.

Searched parliamentary material, employer announcements,2014 conference biography, public professional-profile indexes, ASX submissions, ASIC/taskforce/GIPS queries, member first speech, corporate register/interests and early-work searches. Direct LinkedIn returned999 and parliamentary interests artifact failed restricted-URL fetch; these are source-specific gaps. Broader searches produced unrelated US/UK namesakes, excluded.

Uncorroborated leads retained for a later targeted pass: ContactOut employment aggregation (https://contactout.com/Andrew-Bragg-158117251) suggests Woolworths traineeship February2002–February2003 and EY January2007–September2008. These are not promoted to supported spells or dates without primary/reliable corroboration. No contact details collected. Public corporate-index leads suggest Bragg PPC non-operating by2022 and deregistered2023; company registration is not personal work duration.

Follow-up priorities: identify early orchard/cannery/dairy employers and pay/hours; verify Woolworths/EY lead; Commonwealth payroll and staff-versus-public-service classification; precise FSC departure and party secondments/leave; BCA/campaign overlap; Bragg PPC clients, hours and campaign leave; study dates. Advance nationwide queue before repeating exhausted broad queries.
